metadata.name: WDC06A Ice Core Depth Profile: Isotopic and Gas Age Measurements
metadata.description: A vertical depth profile dataset from the WDC06A ice core in West Antarctica, containing 32 records of isotopic measurements (δ18O, Δ36) and gas age data collected at a single fixed location on 2006-12-09. The data spans depths from approximately 2450m to 2555m, representing a stratigraphic snapshot of paleoclimate conditions.
metadata.temporal: Single day snapshot (depth profile represents time via depth)
